notes: Tail case, all units rewritten. U1 is the zigzag footbridge (dark wood railings, gray piers) -> bright red. U2 masked tower is the middle of three similar towers right of center (x 1721-1796) -> replaced by a TV tower. U3 mask is a patch of tall dry grass on the bank (not bushes). U4 is the white stone balustrade of the landing at the bridge's right end; payload specific. Masks viewed and correct.
